What's that sound?

Listen to a sound your body makes, then choose the word that matches it. There are 15 sounds.

  1. Press the gold button to hear the sound. You can play it again as many times as you like.
  2. Choose A, B, C or D. You can also press the keys A–D or 1–4.
  3. After you answer, you will hear the word spoken.
